<document id="plan-plus">
The Plus plan
Plus costs $5.00 a month. It's built for people who use their card a lot away from BrookLink ATMs or spend some time abroad, and it adds Cushion and a higher savings rate.

## What's included

- **Monthly fee:** $5.00
- **ATMs:** free at BrookLink ATMs, plus 3 free out-of-network withdrawals a month. After that it's $2.50 per withdrawal.
- **Foreign transaction fee:** 1% of the purchase amount
- **Card replacement:** free
- **Expedited card shipping:** $25.00
- **Savings Pockets:** 2.00% APY
- **Cushion:** fee-free coverage up to $50.00 on debit card purchases
- **Daily card spending limit:** $5,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $1,000

## Good to know

Plus includes outgoing international wires for $35.00 each. Your card is plastic, like Basic. Upgrade to Premium if you want the metal card.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away. Downgrades start on your next billing date.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.
</document>
<document id="transfer-limits-premium">
Transfer limits on Premium
These are the transfer and deposit limits on the Premium plan.

| Limit | Amount |
|---|---|
| ACH transfers out, per day | $10,000 |
| ACH transfers out, per calendar month | $50,000 |
| BrookPay, per day | $5,000 |
| Domestic wires, per day | $25,000 |
| Mobile check deposits, per day | $5,000 |
| Cash deposits at stores, per day | $2,000 |

Daily limits reset at midnight Eastern Time. The monthly limit resets on the first day of each calendar month.

## Incoming transfers

There's no limit on money coming in by ACH, wire, direct deposit or BrookPay.

## New devices

For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, BrookPay and external transfers are capped at $500.

## Need more?

Limits are set by plan. Support can't raise them, even for one transfer. Changing plan is the only way to get higher limits.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
What changed in the March 2026 fee update
We updated our fees on March 1, 2026. Here's everything that changed and what stayed the same.

## What changed

- **Plus monthly fee:** from $4.00 to $5.00.
- **Plus foreign transaction fee:** from 1.5% to 1%.
- **Out-of-network ATM fee on Basic and Plus:** from $2.00 to $2.50 per withdrawal.
- **Plus free out-of-network withdrawals:** from 2 to 3 a month.

## What stayed the same

Basic is still free. Premium is still $15.00 a month with no ATM or foreign transaction fees. Card replacement, wire and cash deposit fees didn't change on any plan.

## Why we made these changes

Out-of-network ATM operators raised what they charge us, and we moved part of that cost into the fee. We lowered the Plus foreign transaction fee at the same time, so Plus members who travel pay less overall.

If the new Plus price doesn't work for you, you can move to Basic in the app. The change takes effect on your next billing date.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
</documents>
